resources.string: Upstream cache report is inconsistent: %1$s tokens
Cache not reported upstream: %1$s tokens. Hit rate unknown, not 0%%.
%1$s input from %2$s requests whose model never reports cache is excluded from the rate
Cache is part of input and never added twice. Unreported cache does not mean a miss.
Subagents and title/summary/fast-model requests share the parent conversation id; they are only added to the total when you pick that scope or All.
%1$s tokens (%2$d requests) are left out of the rate: upstream reported no cache field, so they are unknown, not 0%%.
